summary: Iteration 6 end-to-end tested. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py: 12/12 pass. Covers: GET /api/assets/{id}/thresholds returns {defaults:{temperature:{85,100},vibration:{8,12}}, thresholds:{}}; PUT as Production Manager with {temperature:70/90, vibration:5/9} → 200 saved + persisted on GET; PUT as Operator → 403; PUT with warning>critical (temp only, vib only, both) → 400 (three parametrized cases); threshold-aware ingest on CNC-DEMO-01 with warn=70/crit=90 → temp=75 flips to WARNING, temp=92 flips to CRITICAL, temp=60 stays RUNNING; vibration ingest with defaults → vib=15 → CRITICAL, vib=9 → WARNING; PUT thresholds writes audit_log with action='asset.thresholds' and correct entity_id (verified via GET /api/audit-logs); GET /api/assets/{id}/downtime-breakdown returns {days:30, event_count, total_minutes, breakdown:[{reason,minutes}]}; module gate 403 when APM disabled (PUT /api/modules/APM {enabled:false}); breakdown=[] and total_minutes=0 for fresh asset. Frontend (Production Manager on Asset 360 CNC-DEMO-01): 'Thresholds' button [data-testid=thresholds-btn] visible in header; dialog opens with 'Temperature (°C)' and 'Vibration (mm/s)' bands including [data-testid=temp-warning/temp-critical/vib-warning/vib-critical] inputs and 'Use default 85/100' + 'Use default 8/12' reset shortcuts; setting temp warn=100/crit=80 + Save shows error toast 'temperature: warning must be ≤ critical' and dialog stays open; setting warn=70/crit=90 + Save shows 'Thresholds saved' toast, dialog closes; re-open shows persisted 70/90. Downtime root-cause block [data-testid=downtime-reasons] renders with 'No downtime in the last 30 days 🎉' empty state (0 events, 0 min) for CNC-DEMO-01. Operator: login redirects to /operator page (not Asset360) — thresholds-btn count=0, asset-360-page count=0, so button MUST NOT render check is satisfied by route-level gating.
action_items: None for iteration 6. Iteration-4 leftover /api/energy/summary?plant_id filter still open (not retested this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2108 lines — continues to exceed the 700-line guideline. The new thresholds + downtime-breakdown endpoints sit alongside APM code and would be a natural fit for the previously-suggested apm.py router.

PUT /api/assets/{id}/thresholds writes {"thresholds": thresholds} — when payload is {} this stores an empty dict rather than $unset-ing the field. Functionally fine (ingest falls back to defaults on falsy dict), but semantically 'clear' vs 'set-empty' are conflated in the audit log (metadata is {} either way).

Threshold validation is `band.warning > band.critical` (strict). Equal warn=crit is accepted, which produces a zero-width warning band (only 'critical' can ever fire). Consider `>=` to force distinct bands, or explicitly document that warn==crit is allowed.

ingest_telemetry_internal WARNING branch requires `new_status in ("RUNNING","IDLE")`; but the CRITICAL branch unconditionally overwrites new_status. Result: if a payload has NO machine_status and previous status is 'STOPPED'/'OFFLINE', a threshold breach at WARNING level is silently dropped while CRITICAL still fires. Not a bug per spec (spec sent machine_status=RUNNING) but worth documenting.

DowntimeReasonChart catches ALL errors and silently falls back to the empty state. If APM is disabled it will show '🎉' rather than surface the 403 — the parent Asset360 shouldn't even mount the component in that case. Consider gating via feature flag or surfacing the error.

ThresholdEditor treats blank strings as 'clear this metric'. There's no confirmation UI to indicate to the user that saving with blanks will revert to platform defaults; only the helper text mentions it.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (SBF/tenantadmin/Admin@123, SBF/production/Prod@123, SBF/operator/Operator@123). INGEST_KEY read fresh from /app/backend/.env (value not printed).

All test-modified thresholds on CNC-DEMO-01 are reset to {} (defaults) at the end of each test. Iteration-5 seed data still present (TEST_LOG_* maintenance records, UITEST-* asset) — non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operator role redirects on login to /operator (a per-operator dashboard), so the 'thresholds-btn must not render' check is trivially satisfied — Operator never reaches Asset360 via UI navigation. Direct URL /assets/{id} does NOT render Asset360 for Operator either (route gate). Audit endpoint is /api/audit-logs (NOT /api/audit/logs).
